headline: Ansar Allah claims Abha airport + Khamis Mushait airbase strikes
dek: Saree claimed two operations: a drone strike on Abha International Airport that was 'precise' and disrupted air traffic, and a ballistic-missile strike on Khamis Mushait Air Base that was 'direct'. This is separate from the Dammam King Fahd airport claim recorded at 1300-03 and from the…
sources: Ansar Allah military spokesman Yahya Saree, X post Nov 3, relayed by Tribune Pakistan and Dawn liveblog
fault_line: Are the Saudi strikes reaching deeper into the kingdom, or are same-day claim-and-denial posts from one spokesman cancelling each other out?

sections.what_happened: Saree claimed two operations: a drone strike on Abha International Airport that was 'precise' and disrupted air traffic, and a ballistic-missile strike on Khamis Mushait Air Base that was 'direct'. This is separate from the Dammam King Fahd airport claim recorded at 1300-03 and from the Mecca-region drone intercept recorded at 1700-02.
sections.what_verified: Dawn (T3) relay of the claimant's own post; Tribune Pakistan is untiered in the registry and does not count toward corroboration. The strike claim rests on the claimant alone.
sections.what_disputed: Saree himself said on Tuesday that Ansar Allah carried out NO operations toward Saudi territory that day, in his denial of the Mecca-attack claim -- directly in tension with same-day strike claims; the Saudi coalition confirmed only a Mecca-region drone intercept on Tuesday, with no mention of Abha or Khamis Mushait damage. Saree's '109 strikes in 24h' claim remains held at 1300-05 (single-family).
sections.why_matters: Claim vs denial, same spokesman, same day: Abha airport 'hit' -- then 'no operations at all'
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (Saree X post Nov 3; Dawn live entry 08:06pm PKT = 19:06 , in the 19:00-20:00 window but missed by the 2000 scan) -- Ansar Allah claims Abha airport + Khamis Mushait airbase strikes
